version_identity: Paired Markdown/JSON proposal identified by external exact-byte hashes. No self-embedded hash. No prior protocol file is superseded.

prospective_provenance.reason: The frozen primary workflow defined sequential individual and pairwise coding, case-local unblinding, mechanical comparison and closure, but did not fully define RQ6 observation release, receipt/closure semantics, or blindness after primary identities became known.
prospective_provenance.applies_to: Uniformly to all six still-sealed repeat bundles, only after human approval and lock of this exact amendment version and separate operation authorization.
prospective_provenance.evidence_basis: Public frozen protocol and hash-pinned package metadata and builder code only; no repeat stored outputs, rationale values, source mapping values or seed values inspected.

scope.primary_anchors: Each bundle retains its own source model primary as an immutable historical anchor; it is not a new repeat unit or a second primary adjudication.
scope.topology_preserved: Do not merge six one-model source bundles into three cross-model bundles. Bundle-local SIDE_1 is the only source alias needed for each current source bundle.
scope.unexpected_paired_input: If an applicable frozen schema genuinely contains multiple model outputs per observation, split outputs into independent units using its explicit unique source slots and SIDE_n aliases. Unexpected shape in this pinned package is STOP, not permission to reinterpret or regroup it.
scope.frozen_round_schedule: Nine scheduled repeat rounds per model across three groups; 18 model-output review units across six one-source bundles do not change that schedule.

reviewer_unit.definition: One smallest frozen stored model output for one scheduled repeat observation and one source model.
reviewer_unit.selection: Private frozen manifest list position -> exact source artifact hash -> repeat_observations array member with unique stored repeat_number -> stored_output. Preserve array order; require the declared scheduled coverage, never infer from filenames or semantics.
reviewer_unit.missing_invalid_duplicate_or_ambiguous_s: Record discrepancy and STOP release. Do not skip, retry, pick the first match, impute or reconstruct. Apply the prospective insufficient-evidence closure policy when required evidence is unavailable or unusable; this does not waive package integrity or authorize unblinding.
reviewer_unit.reviewer_evidence: Exactly the selected frozen output and its original user request, proposed tool/arguments and frozen neutral reference; no counterpart, future output, historical disposition, hidden fixture metadata, telemetry or provider context.

fresh_blindness.prior_primary_knowledge_rule: prior primary-study knowledge != current bundle mapping knowledge
fresh_blindness.prior_knowledge_interpretation: Knowing the model universe, completed primary study or an already-closed bundle does not itself violate this operational access contract. It does not authorize access to the current sealed mapping or metadata attached to current repeat units.
before_bundle_semantic_freeze_forbidden_: source-model metadata attached to reviewer units
future unreleased observations in the same bundle
source identities attached to current repeat outputs
fresh_blindness.alias_scope: Independent fresh bundle-local aliases, never determined by primary MODEL_A/MODEL_B assignments. The same local alias mapping stays immutable for all observations in that bundle.
fresh_blindness.aliases: SIDE_1 for each existing one-source bundle; SIDE_2 and later aliases only if required by a separately approved applicable multi-source schema. This package remains six one-source bundles.
fresh_blindness.opaque_ids: Independent bundle_review_id and reviewer_unit_id; original manifest position, source bundle identifier, source-indexed case_id and primary blind label are excluded from reviewer-release metadata before local unblind.
fresh_blindness.metadata_sanitization: Strip direct identifying wrapper/source metadata only. Preserve literal user request, arguments, neutral reference and stored output exactly. If literal source evidence itself identifies its source model or carries a forbidden lookup key, withhold the card and report the leak; never edit the evidence to force a pass.
fresh_blindness.review_access_rule: Reviewer attestation or enforced access must establish that independent review occurs only through sanitized current reviewer-release artifacts until all required semantic adjudications in the current bundle are frozen and verified. Record that attestation or enforcement evidence in hash-bound access provenance; no access control is implemented by this document.
fresh_blindness.mapping_blindness_limitation: The contract provides mapping blindness, not a guarantee against stylistic model-identity inference.
fresh_blindness.structural_inference_limitation: The frozen one-source topology and order, prior primary knowledge, or a prior bundle-local reveal may also permit structural or elimination inference. Fresh opaque aliases do not guarantee source anonymity. Possible inference is not access to the current sealed mapping and does not reinstate identity-naive eligibility or an all-six-bundle embargo.
fresh_blindness.local_reveal: Reveal only the completed current bundle mapping to explicitly authorized recipients after every required independent human receipt and unit closure in that bundle validates. No pre-unblind bundle-level rationale assessment is required. Other bundles remain sealed.
fresh_blindness.actual_access_or_leak_failure: STOP release for actual forbidden access, source-identifying metadata or literal identity-bearing evidence. Record failure, do not silently sanitize literal evidence or treat stylistic guesses as proven mapping disclosure.

mapping_commitment_contract.generation_timing: After this amendment is LOCKED, separate operation authorization, reviewer access and continuity gates; before first unit release and before inspecting outputs to choose assignment. No mapping is generated now.
mapping_commitment_contract.entropy: Independent fresh 256-bit cryptographic random seed per bundle plus independent fresh 256-bit commitment nonce; no shared disclosed master seed or reuse of the primary seed.
mapping_commitment_contract.assignment: Read required source slots in their frozen structural order. If multiple slots exist, order them by HMAC-SHA256(bundle_seed, domain-separated protocol/amendment/package identity + frozen manifest hash + private bundle position + exact slot selector); equal keys are STOP. Assign SIDE_1..SIDE_n. A singleton has SIDE_1; operational mapping blindness then relies on sealed mapping/access provenance and opaque IDs; no nontrivial permutation or anonymity guarantee exists.
mapping_commitment_contract.canonical_metadata_encoding: UTF-8 JSON with sorted object keys, original array order, compact comma/colon separators, ensure_ascii=false, no Unicode normalization, no nonfinite numbers; commitment metadata contains strings, integers, booleans and null only, not model confidence values. Version the encoding explicitly.
mapping_commitment_contract.public_mapping_commitment: SHA-256(domain separator + canonical private mapping including nonce). Publish only this digest, opaque bundle ID, algorithm version and commitment timestamp before first card release. Do not publish an unsalted digest of the small set of possible identity assignments.
mapping_commitment_contract.public_source_link: SHA-256(exact source-link domain framing + canonical source_link_preimage including independent_unit_nonce). The mapping, source-link openings and lookup keys stay private to custody before semantic-review completion.
mapping_commitment_contract.card_hash_cycle_avoidance: First hash the prospective reviewer payload excluding source_link_commitment_sha256; bind that payload hash into the salted source link; then insert that commitment and compute the final artifact hash. No self-embedded final artifact hash.
mapping_commitment_contract.public_lookup_key_prohibition: Before all current-bundle semantic receipts and closures are fixed, exclude raw paths, source/bundle hashes, original MODEL_A/MODEL_B labels, source-indexed case IDs/positions and attached source identities from the reviewer-release view. Another bundle mapping and its openings remain sealed throughout.
mapping_commitment_contract.audit_after_local_unblind: After all required current-bundle independent semantic receipts and closures validate and explicit local reveal is authorized, only authorized current-bundle recipients may receive current mapping and commitment/source-link openings to reproduce the bindings. No other bundle mapping, seed, nonce or output is revealed. No global identity embargo or identity-naive eligibility gate is imposed.

encoding_details.text: UTF-8 without BOM; compact JSON; lexicographically sorted Unicode-codepoint object keys; preserve array order; do not normalize Unicode or whitespace inside strings. Escape quotes, reverse solidus and U+0000..U+001F per JSON, using lowercase four-digit Unicode escapes for controls except standard short escapes. No escaped slash or ASCII-only transcoding.
encoding_details.binary_representation: Seed, independent nonce and SHA-256/HMAC digests use lowercase hexadecimal; seeds/nonces exactly64 hex characters. Integers use unsigned base10, no leading zero except0. No float fields in commitments.
encoding_details.manifest_and_observation_order: Exact frozen array order, never filename order.

exact_domains.mapping: ASCII civicgate/rq6/amendment-001/mapping/v1 followed by one NUL byte
exact_domains.alias_assignment: ASCII civicgate/rq6/amendment-001/alias-assignment/v1 followed by one NUL byte
exact_domains.opaque_bundle_id: ASCII civicgate/rq6/amendment-001/bundle-id/v1 followed by one NUL byte
exact_domains.opaque_unit_id: ASCII civicgate/rq6/amendment-001/unit-id/v1 followed by one NUL byte
exact_domains.source_link: ASCII civicgate/rq6/amendment-001/source-link/v1 followed by one NUL byte

mapping_commitment_contract.framing: Each SHA-256/HMAC message is its exact ASCII domain plus one NUL byte plus the canonical JSON object for that operation. Domain text is not a second JSON field. HMAC key is the32 decoded seed bytes. Order HMAC digests by unsigned lexicographic byte order; ties are STOP.
mapping_commitment_contract.opaque_id_generation: bundle_review_id and reviewer_unit_id are full lowercase64-hex HMAC-SHA256(bundle_seed, exact corresponding domain framing + canonical declared opaque-ID preimage). Never use unsalted SHA-256 of enumerable manifest positions or source selectors for opaque IDs. Any opaque-ID collision across current or already-created review objects is STOP, not reassignment or output-dependent selection. This describes initialized reviewer objects only. Pre-mapping failure closure uses the explicit custody-only failure identifier in bundle_closure.pre_mapping_failure_identifier; never generate a seed or mapping for a failure ID.

reviewer_card.source_preservation: Preserve exact strings, values, raw flag order/duplicates, rationale and numeric confidence precision. Store raw selected-output slice hash privately; a derived wrapper is not a replacement source artifact.

human_receipt.freeze: Human-only independent unit coding under OPERATIONALLY_MAPPING_BLIND access; mechanical_stability_seen=false. Frozen disposition, propositions and exact reviewer reason remain immutable after local unblind and later rationale assessment. Do not claim identity-naivety or certainty against inference.

unit_closure.blinded_state_meaning: Blinded means OPERATIONALLY_MAPPING_BLIND direct-access conditions at independent coding, not ignorance of primary identities or immunity to inference.

bundle_closure.closure_success: A validated terminal closure records either complete reviewed coverage with authorized local unblind and a frozen final disposition, or the explicit INSUFFICIENT_REPEAT_EVIDENCE branch. Insufficient closure records absent/unusable evidence without fabricated unit receipts, mechanical stability or premature unblind. Procedural deferral with null final disposition is not a terminal closure. This amendment defines no aggregate treatment for insufficient bundles.

insufficient_branch_nullability.alias_commitment_sha256: May be null only if the evidence limitation was established before authorized mapping generation. Never create a mapping just to populate a failure closure.
insufficient_branch_nullability.provenance_rule: Expected/missing/unusable evidence and failures are explicit, not empty invented receipts. Hashes for absent artifacts are absent entries with reasons, not fabricated digest strings. Stored-source validation failures remain FAIL; closure validation may PASS only for a faithfully recorded insufficient closure, never by declaring failed source controls PASS.

pre_mapping_failure_identifier.when: Evidence limitation is established before authorized mapping/seed generation.
pre_mapping_failure_identifier.role: Custody-only bundle_review_id for the failure closure and its private evidence-limitation ledger. It is not a reviewer ID, alias, mapping or an assignment; binds exactly to the existing frozen manifest record without generating seed/mapping.
pre_mapping_failure_identifier.prohibited_use: Never place this ID in a reviewer card, public commitment or sanitized limitation notice. Initialized reviewer IDs retain the HMAC contract.

bundle_closure.incomplete_coverage_visibility: When every required independent unit has not closed, bundle closure/source hashes/private manifest position/partial observations and any identity-bearing failure provenance remain custody-only. Mapping remains sealed; only a separately authorized sanitized limitation notice may reach the reviewer. A terminal insufficient closure does not create a source-identity reveal exception.

artifact_contracts.card_private_sidecar: The raw selected-output slice hash, original context hash and final card hash are private custody provenance, not reviewer-card fields. SHA-256 is lowercase64 hex; external receipt/artifact hashes are never embedded as their own hash.

bundle_unblind_receipt.audience: Explicitly authorized recipients of the completed current bundle, including the reviewer if authorized. All required independent unit receipts/closures must validate first; no global six-bundle embargo. Nothing opens another bundle.
bundle_unblind_receipt.gate: Every required scheduled independent human adjudication persisted and verified; all unit closures complete and validated; mapping commitment reverified; explicit local-unblind authority bound to this bundle. An insufficient-evidence closure does not waive this gate.

bundle_event_ledger.immutability: Append-only per-bundle hash chain; publish only current permitted opaque metadata. No future outputs/aliases/hashes. Commit means cryptographic commitment and immutable custody record, not Git commit.
bundle_event_ledger.genesis_rule: previous_event_sha256=null if and only if event_sequence=1. For every later event, require the exact SHA-256 of the preceding immutable event, sequential event_sequence and the same current bundle binding.
bundle_event_ledger.incomplete_coverage_visibility: Pre-unblind evidence-limitation events and closure/source lookup provenance are custody-only. No incomplete coverage permits revealing private mapping, source identity or lookup keys to the reviewer.

primitive_type_rules.sha256_fields: Lowercase64 hexadecimal digests. Explicit exceptions: null previous_unit_closure_sha256 only for first unit; null previous_event_sha256 only for event_sequence=1; documented unavailable bundle-closure hashes only under insufficient_branch_nullability. No other implicit null hash exception; no fabricated source hash or self-embedded artifact digest.
primitive_type_rules.identifiers_and_versions: Nonempty strings; reviewer-visible IDs opaque HMAC tokens. The explicit pre-mapping failure bundle_review_id is custody-only and never a reviewer alias or reviewer-visible ID.
primitive_type_rules.positions_and_sequences: positive integers; private manifest position excluded from reviewer view
primitive_type_rules.semantic_propositions: ordered array of unique frozen vocabulary members, possibly empty; do not normalize supplied human coding
primitive_type_rules.frozen_semantic_text: exact Unicode string, no normalization or shortening
primitive_type_rules.flags: exact original JSON array including original order/duplicates; derived normalized sets stored separately only after gate
primitive_type_rules.confidences: exact original numeric value/precision within source schema; no imputation
primitive_type_rules.validation_results: Object mapping declared validators to PASS/FAIL/NOT_TESTABLE/UNVERIFIED. Required normal release/unblind checks must PASS; insufficient closure preserves actual source failures separately and validates its failure provenance without retroactive PASS.
primitive_type_rules.nullable_stability_disposition: One of the six exact frozen enum members for final closure; null only during RQ6_REVIEW_DEFERRED_PENDING_HUMAN_RESOLUTION, which is never terminal bundle closure.
primitive_type_rules.audiences_and_authority: nonempty approved recipient-role declarations and explicit hash-bound authority records; no automated human approval
primitive_type_rules.material_boundary_changed: Boolean, or null only for UNRESOLVED human rationale assessment; enforce rationale_variation_assessment_receipt coherence rules.

rationale_variation_assessment_artifact.gate: After current bundle local unblind and own-model mechanical comparison. Use only its immutable primary anchor and independently frozen repeat coding/rationales. Preserve exact original human propositions and reasons; do not adjudicate units again or perform cross-model pairwise review.

rationale_variation_assessment_receipt.purpose: Prospective bundle-level human assessment after local unblind, not a stability enum or replacement semantic receipt. Independently frozen human rationale propositions are the primary structured evidence; exact frozen reasons/rationales and justified supplemental notes may support assessment. A proposition-set difference is only a candidate requiring human confirmation.

coherence_rules.contradictory_combination: Reject record and STOP; no silent semantic repair.

rationale_variation_assessment_receipt.same_proposition_sets: Identical sets do not prove equivalent boundaries. A genuine material boundary change not captured by the taxonomy may be recorded in an explicit justified human variation note; never add that proposition to a frozen unit receipt.
rationale_variation_assessment_receipt.lexical_only_change: Wording, sentence structure, verbosity, tone or paraphrase alone does not constitute material rationale variation. May be preserved descriptively without triggering STABLE_WITH_RATIONALE_VARIATION.

procedural_effects.when: Assessment UNRESOLVED; or rationale-only material boundary change with stable classification and flags.
procedural_effects.rule: Derived enclosing workflow effects, not extra human assessment receipt fields. Resolve before a final bundle disposition or terminal closure; preserve the assessment and independent coding unchanged.

reviewer_access_provenance.conditional_fields: REVIEWER_ATTESTATION requires exact nonempty human attestation and no invented enforcement hashes. ENFORCED_REVIEWER_RELEASE_ONLY requires actual enforcement evidence hashes; human attestation may be null if not given. These are prospective declarations, not claims of implemented controls.
reviewer_access_provenance.gate: Hash-bind this current-bundle record to each independent human/release receipt; verify no forbidden access before each unit release. Prior primary-study knowledge is allowed. Access policy and operational attestations are not independent semantic coding.
reviewer_access_provenance.private: Operator/authority evidence may contain identity-bearing policy metadata and stays sealed from reviewer. Only permitted sanitized access provenance reaches reviewer before local reveal.

release_sequence: Verify human LOCKED amendment and separate operation authority, OPERATIONALLY_MAPPING_BLIND access provenance, 27 primary closures and all unchanged frozen hashes/diagnostics.
Resolve current bundle in frozen manifest order; any preceding bundle must already have a validated terminal closure. Keep unopened source metadata sealed.
Generate independent immutable bundle-local alias mapping under the locked algorithm; seal it and freeze/publish only mapping commitment and opaque provenance before first release.
Release exactly first or next authorized reviewer unit with exact evidence and empty human form; never expose future units or another bundle.
Human independently semantically adjudicates only that sanitized reviewer unit; persist and validate immutable human receipt.
Validate and record the unit SEMANTICALLY_CLOSED_BLINDED closure; only then release the next required unit. Repeat until all required units independently close.

After every required independent receipt and unit closure validates, reveal only current bundle source mapping under explicit local authority; persist immutable unblind receipt. No preliminary bundle rationale assessment or global six-bundle embargo.
Perform only current source model primary-plus-repeat mechanical comparison under frozen literal classification/flag rules; confidence descriptive only.

Human assesses material rationale variation using independently frozen human propositions/reasons as primary structured evidence; record candidate differences and any justified additive note without recoding units.

Assign one frozen final RQ6 stability disposition under its rules; resolve any procedural deferred state before a final disposition. Persist and validate terminal bundle closure. If required evidence is unavailable/unusable, follow the explicit insufficient-evidence closure branch without fabricating units or unblinding.
Only after current terminal bundle closure validates and next operation is authorized, begin the next frozen bundle. Do not expose it earlier; no automatic aggregate analysis or Judge selection.

cross_model_pairwise.reason: RQ6 characterizes within-model repeat stability, not a second cross-model primary comparison. JC-13 primary pairwise gates and all historical findings remain untouched; no explicit repeat pairwise requirement was found. Any newly discovered frozen requirement is STOP for reconciliation, not silently waived.

stability_contract.literal_classification: No normalization, semantic recoding or inference.
stability_contract.flag_normalization: Preserve emitted lists. For set comparison only, [] and a sole NONE flag represent the empty set; deduplicate other flags. A NONE flag combined with another flag is contradictory and must be recorded as an anomaly, not silently normalized.
stability_contract.normalized_flags_usage: Derived mechanical set representation only; exact substantive stored enum membership after the frozen sole-NONE empty interpretation. Never infer from rationale, human propositions or neutral reference.

disposition_semantics.STABLE: Complete applicable evidence; classification and normalized flags invariant; no human-confirmed material rationale variation under this prospective operational definition. Ordinary wording/paraphrase alone is descriptive and does not trigger the variation disposition.
disposition_semantics.STABLE_WITH_RATIONALE_VARIATION: Complete applicable evidence; classification stable AND normalized flags stable AND material rationale variation independently human-confirmed AND no changed material semantic boundary, preserving the additional frozen guard.
disposition_semantics.STRUCTURED_SIGNAL_VARIABLE: Complete applicable evidence; normalized flag set varies while literal classification invariant.
disposition_semantics.CLASSIFICATION_VARIABLE: Complete applicable evidence; literal classification varies while normalized flag set invariant.
disposition_semantics.MULTI_AXIS_VARIABLE: Complete applicable evidence; both literal classification and normalized flag set vary.
disposition_semantics.INSUFFICIENT_REPEAT_EVIDENCE: Missing/invalid own primary or any required scheduled repeat, or evidence unavailable/unusable for valid independent adjudication, has precedence; no imputation or discretionary enough-valid-repeats threshold.

stability_contract.confidence: Preserve exact numeric values and exact ranges if separately authorized; no rounding to force stability, threshold, preference, correctness inference or disposition branching.

rationale_review.timing: After all independent semantic unit coding is immutable, local unblind and own-model mechanical comparison. This assessment is intentionally after source identity exposure; record it honestly and never revise independent coding.
rationale_review.primary_structured_evidence: Independently frozen primary/repeat rationale propositions; original exact reasons and rationales support human interpretation.
rationale_review.materiality: Only a human-confirmed materially different expressed decision boundary or reasoning proposition across applicable observations. Ordinary wording, sentence structure, verbosity, tone and paraphrase are not material.
rationale_review.proposition_set_difference: Candidate signal only; human confirmation required. Not an automatic stability decision or permission to reconstruct structured flags.
rationale_review.same_proposition_sets: Permit an explicit justified human rationale-variation note for a genuine material boundary change not represented by the taxonomy. Equal sets do not prove equivalence; no frozen proposition is rewritten.
rationale_review.frozen_boundary_guard: A rationale-only changed material semantic boundary with stable structured axes remains procedural deferred/null. Human decisions do not broaden the frozen STABLE_WITH definition to include that change.
rationale_review.wording_only_handling: Preserve ordinary lexical changes descriptively; they do not satisfy this amendment material rationale-variation criterion. This is an explicit prospective human operational refinement of rationale variation, not a claim that historical receipts used this threshold.

stability_contract.frozen_disposition_rule: Human-approved operational convention, locked with this protocol: INSUFFICIENT_REPEAT_EVIDENCE if the primary or a scheduled repeat is missing/invalid. Otherwise MULTI_AXIS_VARIABLE if both classification and normalized flag set vary; CLASSIFICATION_VARIABLE if only classification varies; STRUCTURED_SIGNAL_VARIABLE if only normalized flag set varies. Confidence variation does not change any of these dispositions. With classification and normalized flag set fixed, STABLE_WITH_RATIONALE_VARIATION requires rationale variation without a changed material semantic boundary; STABLE requires no rationale variation, regardless of confidence variation. If a rationale-only change alters the material semantic boundary, preserve it and defer the summary disposition for human review rather than label it stable.

allowed: canonical serialization required by the schema
forbidden: reconstructing flags from human rationale propositions
using neutral-reference flags as model flags
structured_flag_representation_contract.semantic_membership: Exact substantive semantic enum membership is preserved. Normalization changes representation only; raw emitted lists are never changed.
structured_flag_representation_contract.frozen_empty_sentinel: The existing frozen schema defines [] and sole NONE as the empty set. NONE in this sole-sentinel form is not a substantive boundary member being removed; its already-frozen empty meaning is preserved, not reinterpreted.
structured_flag_representation_contract.contradictory_sentinel: NONE combined with any other flag remains a recorded anomaly; STOP/defer pending human resolution, never silently drop NONE or select an arbitrary set.

procedural_deferral.trigger: Unresolved human semantic assessment or contradictory NONE anomaly. In particular, with classification and flags fixed, a rationale-only change in material semantic boundary must be preserved and deferred rather than labeled stable.
procedural_deferral.resolution: Human resolution required before final bundle disposition or terminal closure; never recode frozen unit findings, invent an enum or hide the failure.

preservation.representativeness: A later authorized bundle may describe whether the frozen primary resembles later repeated behavior; descriptive only and never a rewritten primary.
preservation.human_freeze: All independent unit dispositions, rationale propositions and exact reviewer reasons freeze before local unblind. Post-unblind human rationale assessment is a separate additive record built from those frozen findings; it never reopens or recodes them.

proposed_validators.require: 27 distinct completed primary closures and all card/adjudication/pairwise/unblind/mechanical links intact; 524 raw package files and pinned diagnostics unchanged. Historical absent fields remain FIELD_NOT_PRESENT_IN_HISTORICAL_SCHEMA.

Exact pinned six-bundle manifest order and three uniquely numbered repeat selectors per existing one-source bundle. No sorting filenames, skipping, regrouping or output-dependent choice. Unavailable/unusable evidence triggers recorded insufficient policy, not reconstruction.

OPERATIONALLY_MAPPING_BLIND; attestation or enforced sanitized reviewer-release-only access until current bundle semantic freeze. No actual forbidden mapping/identity/source-metadata/future-unit access. Strip wrapper metadata only; withhold identity-bearing literal evidence. Prior primary knowledge is permitted; document inference limitations without claiming identity-naivety.

Exact frozen source bytes and unique selected output, allowed projection, raw strings/flags/confidence preserved, salted provenance and final card hash. Source metadata/openings sealed until local gate.

Exactly next authorized unit; previous unit closure hash verifies before next release. No future unit or next bundle before current terminal closure. Evidence-limitation closure never fakes missing unit closure.

Prospective strict fields/types, frozen semantic enums and exact human text; correct card/release/commitment links; operational mapping-blind access provenance and no mechanical stability seen. First previous-unit hash null only for first unit.
Verified receipt/card/form/release/source-link chain; independent human coding frozen and unit unblinded=false. No source identity or stability fields in independent unit closure.

Every required independent unit human receipt persisted and validated and every required unit closure complete. Commitment revalidated, explicit local authority and recipients, immutable unblind receipt. No pre-unblind rationale-assessment prerequisite or global embargo; no opening for another bundle; insufficient closure never overrides this gate.

Own-model exact primary plus repeats after local unblind. Frozen flag/sentinel/anomaly rule, representation-only membership, exact six final enums, confidence descriptive. Rationale variation human-confirmed from frozen coding; lexical or proposition-set differences alone cannot assign variation; no changed material boundary for STABLE_WITH.

Independent receipt byte hashes unchanged before/after identity exposure and human variation assessment. Append honest post-unblind assessment without recoding; current bundle only, no other bundle mapping/seed/future outputs.

Validate complete or documented INSUFFICIENT_REPEAT_EVIDENCE closure with explicit evidence coverage, hashes/failures and no imputation or fabricated receipts. Null fields only under declared exceptions. Unresolved procedural/null state cannot close. Preserve failed source controls; no aggregate handling or Judge selection assigned.

insufficient_evidence_closure_policy.terminal_closure: A faithful validated INSUFFICIENT_REPEAT_EVIDENCE closure is terminal for the current bundle. insufficient_evidence_closure_policy.aggregate_treatment: Not defined by this amendment. Preserve disposition and provenance only; later aggregate-analysis protocol determines treatment.
insufficient_evidence_closure_policy.incomplete_coverage_visibility: When every required independent unit has not closed, bundle closure/source hashes/private manifest position/partial observations and any identity-bearing failure provenance remain custody-only. Mapping remains sealed; only a separately authorized sanitized limitation notice may reach the reviewer. A terminal insufficient closure does not create a source-identity reveal exception.

isolation_and_later_analysis.aggregate_analysis: Not authorized now. Later separately approved aggregate-analysis protocol decides all aggregate treatment, including insufficient-evidence disposition handling. This amendment specifies no eligibility, denominator, exclusion or ranking policy.
